name: sound-sticker-maker
description: Make WhatsApp stickers that play sound from a video, GIF or photo and any audio.
long_description: Ask Claude to turn a video, GIF or photo plus a sound into a WhatsApp sound sticker. It makes a 512×512 animated WebP under WhatsApp's 1 MB limit with sticker metadata, and the sound as Ogg Opus, saved to your Downloads folder. Send it from WhatsApp Web with the Sound Sticker Maker extension.

tools.name: make_sound_sticker
tools.description: Make a WhatsApp sound sticker from a video, GIF or photo and a sound.
